arc202_b.notes: Official solution independently gives H even => 0; for odd H it reindexes rows into diagonal-down layers, forces layerwise consistent edge directions for odd W, requires a gcd condition for a single cycle, and handles even W by the analogous first-2H-moves argument. Complexity O(H log W) or similar.

arc202_c.notes: Official solution defines factors F_d by R_n=prod_{d|n}F_d and proves that the LCM over selected repunits is exactly the product over the union of divisor-index factors. This matches frozen cyclotomic activation mechanism.

arc202_d.notes: Official solution adds a stay move, separates axes, applies reflection on a doubled cycle, and uses special divide-and-conquer FFT to obtain O(T log^2 T). This confirms frozen O(T*H*W) exact DP is asymptotically non-claim-grade.
